# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(viridis)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```


## 1. Read in data 

```{r}
SE <- readRDS("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/SE_MALDI_01.rds")
peak_anno_updated <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/RCC_Annotated_Mass_Filtered_LM.csv")
```


## 2. Clustering

```{r}
library(clValid)

data <- t(assay(SE, "min_max")) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(25)
testCL<- clValid(data,
                 nClust = 4:20,
                 #clMethods = c("kmeans"),
                 clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),
                 validation="internal", # The internal measures include the connectivity, and Silhouette Width, and Dunn Index.
                 metric="euclidean", 
                 method = "ward", 
                 maxitems = 5000)
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)
```


```{r}
data <- t(assay(SE, "min_max")) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(22)
h_com <- Heatmap(data, 
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        row_km = 8, 
        row_km_repeats = 1000,
        name = "min_max",
        show_row_names=FALSE)+
  Heatmap(scale(data), name = "scaled",
          clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
          show_row_names = FALSE)

h_com <- draw(h_com)


## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_com)
anno <- data %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("ID") %>% select(ID)
anno$cluster_mz <- NA

library(foreach)
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$cluster_mz <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$cluster_mz)))
}
anno$cluster_mz <- unfactor(anno$cluster_mz)

## Add to SE
SE$cluster_mz <- anno$cluster_mz[match(SE$ID, anno$ID)]
```

```{r}
saveRDS(SE, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/SE_MALDI_02.rds")
```



### Survival testing

```{r}
surv_out <- colData(SE) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, cluster_mz) %>% unique()

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ cluster_mz, data = surv_out)

ggsurvplot(fit, 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```
